title: 联想CFO：AI算力需求强劲，资本开支持续攀升
speaker: Winston Chang

segments.en: In terms of hyperscale they're increasing their catbex where you're hearing catbex only
segments.zh: 超大规模厂商正在增加资本开支，你听到的资本开支只是其中一部分

segments.en: Directionally going one way which is up and you're seeing it either in triple digit or even in sometimes triple
segments.zh: 方向只有一个，就是向上，你看到的是三位数甚至有时是三位数的增长

segments.en: Multiple in terms of growth of that catbex, right? So I think from that perspective we're only seeing demand coming stronger
segments.zh: 资本开支成倍增长，从这个角度看，我们只看到需求越来越强

segments.en: And I think you're not even seeing the AI natives are starting to raise capital
segments.zh: 而且你还没看到AI原生企业开始融资

segments.en: They a lot of them have not gone public and once they go public they will need to spend more as well
segments.zh: 其中很多还没上市，一旦上市，它们也需要增加支出

segments.en: So I think from that perspective the market I think it's still got many years to go in terms of that ramp up
segments.zh: 所以从这个角度看，市场还有多年的增长空间
